verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that, when Decision Center is enabled, merchants can configure policies at the Sale checkpoint that apply to submitted orders. That implies some merchant-controlled decisioning, and decisions can be retrieved via the Get Decision API. Nothing shows mapping score ranges to actions or tuning thresholds. missing for 10: explicit score-range-to-action mapping, configurable thresholds, documented allow/review/block action set, 3DS step-up action, Checkout-checkpoint policy detail, independent corroboration.
